verses.text: Ayik ix k'och winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé t'a chonhab' Iconio chi', yaman ix och heb' winh t'a yol spatil sculto heb' yetisraelal. Te wach' ix yutej heb' winh yalanel slolonel Dios ta'. Yuj chi', tzijtum heb' israel ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol yet' pax heb' manh israelok.
Palta ay heb' israel maj ak'anochlaj t'a sk'o'ol, ix yak'an sk'o'ol juntzanh heb' manh israelok heb', yik schichonoch sk'o'ol heb' t'a heb' creyente chi'.

Haxo winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', niwan tiempo ix aj heb' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Maj xiwlaj heb' winh yalanel yab'ixal swach'k'olal Kajal Jesús, haxo Kajal chi' ix ch'oxani to yel syal heb' winh, yujto ix yak' spoder t'a heb' winh sch'oxan juntzanh milagro.
Palta haxo heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' chi', cha poj ix aj heb'. Nanhal heb' ix kan yet' heb' israel chi'. Haxo nanhalxo heb', a yet' heb' schekab' Jesús chi' ix och heb'.

Haxo heb' israel chi' yet' juntzanh heb' manh israelok, ix laj slajtiej sb'a heb' yet' heb' skuchb'umal jun chonhab' chi'. Ix yalan heb' to ol yak' chukal heb' t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi', ol sjulancham heb' winh heb' sna'ani.

Haxo ix yab'an spekal jun ix alchaj chi' heb' winh t'a spatik, ix b'at heb' winh elelal. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a Listra yet' t'a Derbe t'a yol yik Licaonia. Ix ek' heb' winh t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a slak'anil chi'.
Hata' ix ek' heb' winh yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.
Ha t'a chonhab' Listra ay jun winh atax yaljinak max yal sb'eyi. Malaj b'aj sb'ey jab'ok winh. Haxo junel k'ojanem winh,
wan yab'an winh tas syal winhaj Pablo. Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' ix och k'elan t'a winh. Ix yilan winh to syak'och winh t'a sk'o'ol to syal sb'oxi winh yuj Dios.
Yuj chi' te cha'anh ix yal winh t'a winh: --K'e'anh wa'an, tojol tzach ajk'e linhan, xchi winh. T'a jun rato chi', ix k'e linhan winh. Ix och ijan winh sb'eyek'i.

Ayik ix yilan heb' anima tas jun ix sk'ulej winhaj Pablo chi', ix och ijan heb' yalan cha'anh t'a sti' heb' aj Licaonia chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha heb' ko diosal ix yak'och sb'a heb' anima'il, ix emul heb' t'a ko kal, xchi heb'.
Ha winhaj Bernabé, Júpiter ix sb'iej winh yuj heb'. Haxo winhaj Pablo, Mercurio ix yak' heb' sb'iok winh, yujto a winh ix lolon t'a skal heb'.

Ay jun winh sacerdote'al Júpiter chi', yajal yaj winh t'a stemplo Júpiter t'a stiel chonhab'. Ix b'at yik'kot juntzanh nok' toro winh yet' juntzanh xumakil te te'. Haxo yet' heb' anima chi' smasanil ijan ix yak' jun silab' nhusb'il winh t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi'.

Palta haxo yik ix yab'an heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi', ix snhik'chitej spichul heb' winh sch'oxanel skusk'olal. Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh t'a skal heb' anima, te cha'anh ix yal heb' winh t'a skal heb' icha tik:

--Ex ketanima'il, ¿tas yuj icha tik tzeyutej he b'a? Ha onh tik, anima onh icha ex tik. Yuj chi' tzul kal t'ayex to tzeyaktejkan juntzanh he b'eyb'al tik, yujto nab'anhej tzeyixtej he b'a. K'exek he b'eyb'al, ak'ek och he pensar t'a jun Dios to t'a wal yel pitzan. A' b'ojinak satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik. Sb'oannak pax ha' mar yet' masanil tastak.
T'a peka', tonhej ix yil Dios tas ix sk'ulej heb' anima, ix yak'an snib'ej heb'.
Palta ix yak' ko pensar yik skojtakej eli tas yaji ayik syak'ankot nhab' t'a kib'anh. Syak'an masanil tas skawej. A' tz'ak'an masanil tas sko wa''a. Syak'anpax ko tzalajk'olal, xchi heb' winh.

Palta ayik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', puralxonhej ix och wa'an heb' anima chi' skachji yuj heb' winh. Yujto snib'ej heb' syak' nok' wakax chi' silab'il t'a heb' winh.

Palta ay jaywanh heb' israel aj Antioquía yik Pisidia ix k'och yet' jaywanhxo heb' aj Iconio. Ix yak'an sk'o'ol heb' anima chi' heb'. Yuj chi', ix laj sjuloch k'e'en k'e'en heb' t'a winhaj Pablo chi'. Haxo ix sna'an heb' to toxo ix cham winh, ix snheranb'at winh heb', ix syumankanel winh heb' t'a stiel chonhab' chi'.
Palta ix k'och hoyan heb' creyente t'a stz'ey winh, ix k'ex wa'an winh. Ix ochxi winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'atxi winh yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a chonhab' Derbe.

Hata' ix ek' yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il heb' winh. Tzijtum anima ix ak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a sk'o'ol. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh. Ix ek'xi heb' winh t'a chonhab' Listra, t'a Iconio yet' t'a Antioquía yik Pisidia chi'.

Ix laj ek' heb' winh yiptzitej heb' creyente t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix ek' ak'jikan stek'anil spensar heb' yuj heb' winh. Ix yalankan heb' winh icha tik t'a heb': --Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a eyak'anoch Kajal Jesús t'a he k'o'ol, yujto ayik manto onh k'och t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, yowalil niwan yahelal ol ja t'a kib'anh, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix ek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a junjun iglesia, ix yak'och yopisio heb' tz'och anciano'al heb' winh. Ix yak'an lesal heb' winh t'a Dios, ix och pax heb' winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jikanoch heb' creyente ab'enal t'a yol sk'ab' Kajal Jesús, haton jun ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a yol yik Pisidia. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a Panfilia.
Ix yalanel slolonel Dios heb' winh t'a chonhab' Perge. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a chonhab' Atalia.

Haxo ta' ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun barco. Ix jax heb' winh t'a Antioquía yik Siria. Haton t'a jun chonhab' chi' sk'annak swach'k'olal Dios heb' creyente t'a yib'anh winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', yik ix b'at yalankanel slolonel Dios heb' winh. Xal tikne'ik ix yik' sb'a jun smunlajel heb' winh chi'.

Ayik ix k'ochxi heb' winh, ix laj yawtejkot heb' creyente heb' winh ayek' ta'. Ix yalan heb' winh t'a heb' jantak tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' heb' winh. Ix laj yalanpax heb' winh to a Kajal Jesús ix cha'an yak'och heb' manh israelok t'a sk'o'ol.
Najtil ix aj heb' winh yet' heb' creyente chi' ta'.
